name: liquid-merge-heading
title: Liquid Merge Heading
description: Two words drift toward each other on a loop, blur at the seam, and merge into one with a gooey SVG filter — then pull apart again. The metaball effect is a filter chain, not a physics engine.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Ambient Loop: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
